Who We Are
Trusted Energy Partner for Investors, Farmers & Feed Manufacturers
Operating state-of-the-art facilities in Union City, Indiana and Colwich, Kansas, Cardinal Ethanol is a leading ethanol and co-product producer committed to delivering reliable, renewable energy solutions and sustainable agricultural products that fuel America’s economy while supporting local agriculture and rural growth.
Our strategically located facilities produce fuel-grade ethanol, premium DDGS, high-value corn oil, and food-grade CO2 that serve regional and national markets.
Founded: 2005
Locations: Union City, Indiana – Colwich, Kansas
Capacity: Over 200 million gallons

Ethanol
Low-Carbon Fuel
Cardinal Ethanol produces premium fuel-grade ethanol that blends with gasoline to power millions of vehicles while reducing carbon emissions. Our ethanol offers higher octane, improved engine performance, and lower greenhouse gas impact than conventional gasoline.
Lower emissions than 100% gasoline
High-performance fuel with increased octane
Reliable supply for regional and national fuel blenders
Biodegradable and water-soluble
Murex – contact for ethanol prices and purchasing: 972-735-5345
Feed Co-products
High-Performance Nutrition
Distillers grains (DDGS) rich in protein and fat, serving as a premium feed ingredient for livestock markets from the Midwest to the Pacific Rim.
320,000+ tons produced annually
High protein content for livestock nutrition
Consistent quality and palatability
Sustainable animal feed solution
HiPro Distillers – CFP (Corn Fermented Protein) / Protomax – a high protein feed produced at both plants
WCBS (Wet Corn Bran w/Solubles) / Solbran – produced at Colwich – a great energy source for local cattle feedlots
CHS – contact for market prices and purchasing: 800-769-1066
Distiller's Corn Oil
High-Value Renewable Feedstock
A low-carbon essential ingredient for the rapidly expanding Renewable Diesel and Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) industries.
Premium fat source for livestock feeds
Consistent nutritional profile
Bio and renewable diesel feedstock applications across the country
Reliable supply for regional partners
Biogenic CO2
Leading the Path to Net-Zero Ethanol
Capturing high-purity biogenic CO2 from our fermentation process and permanently storing it in deep geologic formations to eliminate our environmental footprint.
Permanent Geologic Storage : Securely sequestered underground to ensure CO2 remains out of the atmosphere.
Significant CI Reduction : A primary driver in lowering the Carbon Intensity (CI) score of our ethanol.
Environmental Stewardship : Transitioning from commercial sales to long-term climate-positive solutions.
Verified Carbon Removal : Utilizing rigorous monitoring and reporting standards for permanent carbon abatement.
